text:
Type: plaid flatweave runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or narrow floor; hallway, kitchen, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: flat woven fibers, slightly textured weave
Colors: light cool gray-blue, warm beige, soft peach
Shape: long narrow runner, soft tartan plaid of crossing stripes, flat low profile, clean bound edges, light visual weight
Feel: soft, calm, homey
Goes with: warm wood floors, navy or white cabinetry, brass accents; farmhouse or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Plaid Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Flatweave, Light Gray, Beige
product.description: If you ever wanted to try something classy for your room, a transitional plaid rug in light grey and beige could make a fresh statement. Made from environmentally sensitive PET, it offers durability as well as stylish design. 2' 6" x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
